title: Product Designer (UI/UX)

responsibilities: Conduct user interviews, build wireframes, maintain Figma component libraries, work alongside engineering.

responsibilities: Design print and digital layouts; produce engaging promotional graphics; edit brand imagery in Photoshop and Illustrator.

title: Operations Manager
description: Oversee daily warehouse logistics, fleet scheduling, supplier procurement, and operational process control.
responsibilities: Manage warehouse staff; optimize supply chain throughput; coordinate inventory replenishment; track driver compliance and vendor contracts.
mandatory_qualifications: 5+ years logistics and warehouse operations management required

title: Senior Business Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinate cross-functional operational workflows, facilities management, procurement, and vendor billing.
responsibilities: Streamline back-office administration; manage regional office facilities; review vendor contracts; enforce operational compliance.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description: Drive business analytics, revenue forecasting, user retention analysis, and executive KPI reporting.
responsibilities: Build automated Tableau dashboards; write complex SQL data extraction queries; design multivariate A/B testing protocols; present actionable insights to leadership.
mandatory_qualifications: Strong proficiency in advanced SQL and 4+ years analytics experience

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Translate clinical and operational data into clear business intelligence dashboards and statistical reports.
responsibilities: Construct SQL data pipelines; build automated Power BI / Tableau reports; collaborate with department heads on KPI definitions.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: Design, build, and deploy resilient scalable web applications and microservices using TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

mandatory_qualifications: B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical engineering experience

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Build accessible, responsive, state-of-the-art interactive web interfaces.
responsibilities: Translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect React components; optimize web performance; maintain component testing suite.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description: Scale paid acquisition, organic search, and retention loops across digital marketing channels.
responsibilities: Manage paid ad spend on Google and Meta; optimize landing page conversion rates; analyze CAC and LTV; run growth experimentation sprints.

responsibilities: Execute full sales cycle from discovery to contract negotiation; maintain CRM hygiene; consistently exceed quarterly revenue quotas.
mandatory_qualifications: Track record of meeting or exceeding $1M+ ARR quota

title: Customer Success Specialist
description: Partner with incoming business customers to guarantee onboarding success and rapid time-to-value.
responsibilities: Resolve tier-2 customer support inquiries; run weekly customer check-in webinars; document bug reports and product feedback for engineering.
